acceptance: aipo.toml accepts pinned GitHub dependency sources with an exact SemVer version, repository slug, lowercase 40-hex commit and safe relative subpath; path dependencies remain compatible.

The package core resolves a root plus transitive pinned GitHub inputs through the GitHubFetcher seam, preserves source provenance and digests, validates coordinates, versions, capabilities, duplicates and cycles, and writes a complete deterministic lock projection.

The opt-in github-http fetch command recursively fetches every reachable GitHub source, uses the existing atomic digest-verified cache, and writes the root snapshot plus full graph lockfile without executing lifecycle code.
A remote artifact declaring a local path dependency fails closed; local path resolution remains available for local packages.
run, check, build, disasm, package lock and package audit never access the network or mutate the cache; only fetch-github enables the HTTP adapter.

Positive and negative tests cover manifest round-trip, source validation, offline recursive graph resolution, cache reuse, remote local-path rejection, CLI argument validation and existing local behavior; repository gates remain green.

evidence.description: aipo-package with all features passed 45 tests, including pinned GitHub manifest round-trip, source validation, recursive offline graph resolution, cache reuse, local-path rejection and graph lock projection.

aipo-cli with github-http passed 16 package integration tests, including explicit fetch argument validation and denial of remote dependencies from local package lock without the explicit fetch operation.
cargo test --workspace --all-targets and cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features passed; the default build remains network-free and the opt-in build resolves the complete pinned graph.
cargo fmt --all -- --check and cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings passed after the final changes.

cargo doc --workspace --no-deps, cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --all-features, node crates/aipo-js/runtime/selftest.mjs, cargo deny check advisories bans licenses sources, cargo audit, prumo validate . and prumo doctor . all passed.
ADP-007, CLI reference, GitHub fetch security contract and diagnostics catalog document the manifest syntax, recursive explicit fetch, cache policy, 256-package bound, diagnostics and non-goals.

non_goals: Private repositories, tokens, OAuth, credentials or authenticated GitHub API requests
Automatic network access from run, check, build, disasm, package lock or package audit
Remote artifacts with local path dependencies or package-internal submodules
Registry publication, version solving, signatures, attestations and cache eviction
objective: Allow pinned GitHub dependencies in aipo.toml, resolve a complete public graph only through the opt-in fetch-github command, preserve cache and lock provenance, and keep normal package commands network-free
title: Explicit remote dependency graph
